title: Prove a sharp variance-sensitive compiler tail screen (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. The new application gives a sharp worst-case compiler tail screen from the variance of normalized target log ranks:

```text
0<x<p<1, 0<v<=p(1-p), q=T(t)/P(t)>=1
b=p+v/p
all laws on the containing interval pass iff
q exp[-D(x/b || p/b)] < 1
```

The two-moment exponential majorant and its two-point equality law are classical, credited to Seneta and Weber's 1982 Corollary 1(ii) and their Brook predecessor. The contribution is the optimized gate application, its strict equality scope and a new integer-histogram separation, produced by Nick Petalas. No new probability inequality is claimed.

For `W4=32,W64=16,W1024=2,P32=43,t=1/2`, the new guarantee is exactly `128/129<1`, with a literal rational tail parameter `lambda=1/6`. The older range-and-mean statistical screen cannot certify this fixture. This changes a sufficient statistical screen, not the underlying scalar-to-gate criterion or the selected frontier.

[Proof and precise scope](research/variance-tail-gate/PROOF.md), [verifier](research/variance-tail-gate/verify.py), [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19299691).

Credit Nick Petalas PR5254 for the normalized range/mean screen, Ali Romman PR5345 for the distinct prescribed-interior-mass screen, Dillon Amburgey PR4532 for scalar-to-gate equivalence, zxv PR4436/4483, Jacob Alan Sussman, Ryanson Jonathan PR4459 and their retained compiler/native/outer lineage. Their proofs are cited, not reverified as this deliverable. The classical source is [Seneta and Weber](https://doi.org/10.1017/S144678870001884X). Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

Before: the older screen's optimized criterion has eighth power `2^60/(3^3*5^5*43^8)>1`. After: the new guaranteed bound is `128/129`, and direct rank-ratio cube-root enclosures independently certify the literal passing point.

At head `c6122fdda5a1d3c4aaeadb51037a609ba1641a8a`, local CPython 3.12.15 checks pass:

- All 242 nonzero quarter-grid weight-vector fixtures, 928 transform comparisons, 6496 pointwise bounds including 3212 beyond the extremal support point, 1080 tariff cases, 4320 off-minimum trials and 36 comparisons of the two screens.
- The integer fixture, two same-moment equality-boundary laws, twelve invalid-input/capacity cases and four semantic controls. Scientific checks remain enabled under optimization.
- Warning-strict direct normal and optimized checks, both registered commands, metadata/source pins, AST/function inspection and committed-byte/source-history preflight. Direct checks take about 0.20 seconds each locally; the full registered launcher takes about 0.69 seconds. These are budget observations, not runtime improvement claims. Every registered command is below five minutes.
- Official committed export and declared-input integrity; normal and optimized replay from a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH; all seven exported files retain bytes/modes. Three actual verifier corruptions reject in both Python modes. Generated receipts bind package files by SHA256.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/variance-tail-gate/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/variance-tail-gate/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/variance-tail-gate
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/variance-tail-gate --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 interpreter can replace the absolute path. Standard library only. Expected markers are `PASS_VARIANCE_TAIL_GATE`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The all-law theorem rests on the written proof and the cited classical/gate premises. Finite replay corroborates only its declared cases.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Sharpness is over probability laws on a declared containing interval. The extremal law need not be realizable by integer ranks or counts. Requiring both interval endpoints to occur can exclude that law; the proof explicitly states the resulting equality distinction. Failure of this sufficient screen is inconclusive for an individual histogram.

The histograms are abstract. Mirror coverage, recurrence funding, native preparation, arbitrary-input physical caller correctness, owned restoration, precision, movement, stock, supplier admission and outer multiplication obligations are not proved or replayed. No selected cold replay, native suite, Lean or Docker run is claimed. No new kappa or discharge of any framework assumption is claimed. All registered package obligations ran locally.

## Open next questions

- Apply the variance screen to one changed source-bound native profile that also passes every mirror and recurrence predicate. First bind the exact productive/paid histograms and mirror intervals; native semantics, restoration and the full physical bill remain blockers.
- Produce a directed variance upper enclosure for one actual profile. First use the sign of the quadratic coefficient and bound its log moments; no source-bound interval implementation or completed caller is supplied here.

## Related open work

The publication refresh read all 364 open PR titles/bodies, the latest handoff claims and local reservations, plus distinctive main and merged searches. No open PR studying this mean-variance adaptive tail criterion or the same integer histogram was found. PR5254 and PR5345 are merged predecessors with different statistical contracts. Sparse historical notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits. No extra computations were run to validate another contribution or compare its numbers.

The completion refresh inspected the nine open account PR records created since the CLAIM, including this PR. None of the other eight studies this mean-variance compiler tail criterion or the same integer histogram. No shared-instance numerical comparison or extra computation of another contribution was needed.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks, `plan` and `replay (research/variance-tail-gate)`, passed at exact head `c6122fdda5a1d3c4aaeadb51037a609ba1641a8a` in [Registered research packages run 41106239987](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41106239987). The completed checks were read once; separate run metadata confirms completed status, success and the matching head SHA. The replay runs both registered warning-strict normal and optimized commands.

All local registered, direct, publication/source-history, export and mutation checks listed above also passed. Hosted replay certifies execution of the declared finite checks and controls. It does not establish independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the written theorem. The native, mirror/recurrence, physical caller and multiplication obligations remain as stated above.

## Merge Danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: one isolated six-file research package. Shared code, predecessor files and selected scientific artifacts are unchanged.
